description: Input schema for a PEP being converted into refgenie-registry genome YAML files by tools/pep_to_genome_yaml.py. One sample per genome assembly. Validated with eido before anything is written, so a PEP missing a required column fails immediately rather than after half an import.

sample_name.description: Becomes the genome `name` and the YAML filename stem.

fasta_url.description: Download URL for the FASTA. Becomes fasta.sources[0].url.

fasta_provider.description: Optional. Overrides the provider inferred from the URL host.

ncbi_id.description: Optional assembly accession (GCA_/GCF_). Becomes assembly.accession, and its prefix decides assembly.source.

assembly_source.description: Optional. Overrides the source inferred from the accession prefix.

assembly_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Becomes fhr.date_created; other formats are ignored.

masking.description: Optional. Becomes the top-level masking field.

genome_name.description: Optional. Becomes an alias when it differs from sample_name.

md5.description: Optional MD5 of the compressed FASTA.

sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the uncompressed FASTA. Defaults to the compute_on_registration sentinel.

seqcol_digest.description: Optional. When absent the genome is emitted with seqcol.compute: true.

id_id.description: Optional BioSample accession. Emitted as fhr.identifier biosample:<value> when it starts with SAM.
